components.name: utils
components.title: Utils
components.description: The cn helper for merging Tailwind classes.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Displays a button with multiple variants and sizes.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual style of the button.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the variant styles.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and reduces opacity.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer sections.

props.name: Card / CardHeader / CardContent / CardFooter
props.description: Container parts. Accept className and all div props.

props.name: CardTitle / CardDescription
props.description: Pre-styled typography for the header section.

components.name: spotlight
components.title: Spotlight
components.description: A container with a soft glow that follows the cursor. Perfect for hero sections.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the glow in px.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Glow strength from 0 to 1.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the container.

components.name: dot-grid
components.title: Dot Grid
components.description: A dotted texture layer that dissolves outward. Drop it under any section.

props.name: size
props.description: Distance between dots in px.

props.name: dot
props.description: Dot color, any CSS color.

props.name: mask
props.description: CSS mask so the field dissolves outward.

components.name: marquee
components.title: Marquee
components.description: An infinite scrolling row with edge fade. Children loop seamlessly.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverse the scroll direction.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause scrolling while hovered.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds per loop.

components.name: number-ticker
components.title: Number Ticker
components.description: Counts up to a value the first time it scrolls into view.

props.name: value
props.description: Target value to count up to.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places to display.

props.name: prefix / suffix
props.description: Text placed before or after the number.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the count takes.

components.name: scroll-progress
components.title: Scroll Progress
components.description: A spring-smoothed bar that tracks document scroll.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness.

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping.

props.name: className
props.description: Height, color, and position of the bar.

components.name: glare-card
components.title: Glare Card
components.description: A card with a soft glare that follows the pointer.

props.name: size
props.description: Radius of the glare in px.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Peak glare opacity from 0 to 1.

components.name: animated-list
components.title: Animated List
components.description: Reveals its children in sequence when scrolled into view.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between each child.

props.name: distance
props.description: Travel distance in px.

props.name: amount
props.description: Fraction visible before it plays.

components.name: border-beam
components.title: Border Beam
components.description: A light travelling around the border of any element.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds per revolution.

props.name: size
props.description: Beam width in px.

props.name: offset
props.description: Starting offset along the border, in degrees.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the beam starts.

components.name: text-reveal
components.title: Text Reveal
components.description: Blurs and lifts each word into place, in sequence.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between each word.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before the first word.

props.name: amount
props.description: Fraction visible before it plays.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Panels unfold from a hairline, each open on its own.

props.name: items
props.description: Questions and answers. Each item is { question, answer }.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Indices open on first render.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow more than one panel open at once.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the container.

components.name: gauge
components.title: Gauge
components.description: A half-circle meter whose needle springs to the value.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value, 0-100.

props.name: label
props.description: Caption under the reading.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Value at or above which the peak marker flashes.

props.name: sweep
props.description: Half sweep in degrees from each side of the arc.

components.name: loader-set
components.title: Loader Set
components.description: Ring, dots, bar, and skeleton, each with a finished state.

props.name: done
props.description: Flips every loader into its completion state.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the grid.

components.name: avatar-stack
components.title: Avatar Stack
components.description: Overlapping avatars that fan out on hover and focus.

props.name: people
props.description: Initials or image URLs, in order.

props.name: max
props.description: How many to show before the overflow count.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the container.

components.name: number-stepper
components.title: Number Stepper
components.description: Minus and plus around a display that rolls digit by digit.

props.name: label
props.description: Text shown beside the control.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled current value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the clamped next value.

props.name: min / max
props.description: Bounds the value and disables the end buttons.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount added or removed per press.

components.name: expanding-search
components.title: Expanding Search
components.description: A pill that grows into a real input and stays clickable.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible label for the input.

props.name: width
props.description: Expanded width in pixels.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called on every keystroke and on clear.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the wrapper.

components.name: otp-input
components.title: OTP Input
components.description: One-time-code slots with paste fan-out and success rings.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of slots.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled code or the starting code.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the code on every edit.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once every slot is filled.

props.name: type
props.description: Which characters each slot accepts.

props.name: status
props.description: Success tints the rings, error shakes the row.

props.name: size
props.description: Slot dimensions.

components.name: code-block
components.title: Code Block
components.description: Framed code with line numbers and copy, no highlighter needed.

props.name: code
props.description: The source to display.

props.name: language
props.description: Shown in the header when no filename is given.

props.name: filename
props.description: File name shown in the header bar.

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Gutter with right-aligned line numbers.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the frame.

components.name: gooey-nav
components.title: Gooey Nav
components.description: Segmented nav where the active pill melts between stops.

props.name: items
props.description: Segments. Plain strings render buttons, hrefs render anchors.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled active index or the starting index.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the picked segment.

props.name: activeColor
props.description: Fill of the blob.

components.name: magnetic-button
components.title: Magnetic Button
components.description: A button that leans toward the cursor, then settles.

props.name: strength
props.description: How far the button follows the cursor, 0 to 1.

props.name: children
props.description: Label. Accepts every other native button prop too.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the pill.

components.name: text-scramble
components.title: Text Scramble
components.description: Headlines that decode through glyphs, left to right.

props.name: text
props.description: The copy. Monospace keeps the width steady.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the wrapper.

components.name: compare-slider
components.title: Compare Slider
components.description: Before and after split by a draggable divider.

props.name: before / after
props.description: The two layers. Images should share dimensions.

props.name: initial
props.description: Start position, 0 to 1.

props.name: beforeLabel / afterLabel
props.description: Edge tags that fade as the divider nears.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the rounded position on move.

components.name: slide-to-confirm
components.title: Slide to Confirm
components.description: A knob that must travel to commit, flicks count too.

props.name: label
props.description: Idle hint that fades as the knob travels.

props.name: confirmedLabel
props.description: Shown with a check after completion.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called once the knob completes. Auto-resets after 2s.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the track.

components.name: hold-to-delete
components.title: Hold to Delete
components.description: A destructive action that only fires if you keep holding.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the press must be held before it fires.

props.name: label / doneLabel
props.description: Idle and completed copy.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called once the hold completes. Resets after 2s.

components.name: tilt-card
components.title: Tilt Card
components.description: A card that tips toward the pointer with real perspective.

props.name: max
props.description: Peak rotation in degrees on each axis.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective distance in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the moving card.

components.name: segmented-control
components.title: Segmented Control
components.description: A radio group where the selection pill stretches as it travels.

props.name: options
props.description: Segment labels, shared equally.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected option.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected option.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the radio group.

components.name: sparkline
components.title: Sparkline
components.description: A self-drawing line chart that scales to any width.

props.name: data
props.description: The series to draw. Scaled to the viewBox.

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke and fill colour.

props.name: area
props.description: Fill the area under the line.

props.name: animate
props.description: Draw the line when it first enters view.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in pixels. Width stays fluid.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description of the series.

components.name: task-list
components.title: Task List
components.description: Checklist where finishing a row sweeps a strike across it.

props.name: tasks / defaultTasks
props.description: Controlled list, or the starting list. Items are { id, label, done }.

props.name: onTasksChange
props.description: Called with the full list after a toggle.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the list.

components.name: word-rotator
components.title: Word Rotator
components.description: Cycles words by moving the letters they share.

props.name: words
props.description: The words to cycle through. Shared letters survive a swap.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds per word.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stops rotation and returns to the first word.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged with the wrapper.
